title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt — Episode8 A New Step Forward

meta.Event Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: A few days later - After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, Airi's here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here already. I thought I was gonna be the early bird.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but since we're all here now, shall we start our dance practice?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, before we do...
Minori, there's something I need to tell you. Actually, I'd like for you all to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something you'd like to tell us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it has to do with Minori switching to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You knew, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I was the one who told her!
I decided to ask her about what you said, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, um... Airi...
What do you want to tell us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori, after we spoke that time, all this doubt started welling up inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because I didn't want you and your friends to start drifting apart after you made the decision to go credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I asked KAITO and Shizuku about this, and even gave it some more thought on my own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As overbearing as this is going to sound, I want you to hear what I felt...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please, tell me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I told myself early on that switching to the credit-based course meant some gaps would form between me and my friends...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But KAITO explained how the bonds people form with one another aren't so easily broken.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: KAITO said that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. And the next day, I happened to see one of my old friends... So I went to talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, how'd that go...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were both nervous about talking at first, so there was some awkwardness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But then, my friend said that she'd also been wanting to talk with me... That was when I realized that we both wanted to have a real friendship again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And now, we're messaging each other and talking like old times...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, Minori, I realized what I said to you wasn't entirely correct.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hold that you will need to make some sacrifices if you go credit-based, including spending less time with your friends. That's just unavoidable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Some may end up drifting away...
But I don't believe that's a reason to give up on them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd like to answer your question again. But in a different way this time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The bonds you've forged with your friends won't easily break. The connections you've established with them will endure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It may not seem that way at times moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't want you to give up on them. You can always reset things by telling each other exactly how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's all I wanted to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Airi.
I appreciate you telling us this story.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The truth is, I've been thinking a lot about what you and Haruka told me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I even asked the teachers about it and did a little research on my own about how I should proceed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I think I've found my answer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your story only reinforced my decision, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've made up my mind...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. We ended up making the same decision...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The same decision...? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm also switching back to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because it's the best way for us to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, absolutely!
Let's spread lots and lots of hope together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That's it. We're all going to be credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which means we'll be able to do even more as idols moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Juggling school and work each day won't be easy, and the relationships we have with our friends will also start changing.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm sure we'll have our share of problems to deal with...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I'm confident that we'll do just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. No, nothing's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Minori, you seem much more confident now compared to the other day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! That's because I gave this decision a lot of thought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A lot of thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Minori?
Would you mind telling me more about what you did during that time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna hear too...
It'll be good for us to understand what your thought process was.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, sure...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After I spoke to you and Haruka, Airi, I...
